CFML Language Reference: Functions

CreateODBCTime

Converts the time part of a date/time value or string into an ODBC time escape such as {t '21:42:00'}. The date part is dropped.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

CreateODBCTime(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one, for example "9:42 PM".

Returns

A string in the form {t 'hh:mm:ss'} using the 24-hour clock.

Usage

Handy for SQL columns that store only a time of day, such as an opening hour or a scheduled task time. See CreateODBCDate and CreateODBCDateTime for the other two escapes.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Input</TH><TH>CreateODBCTime</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>"9:42 PM"</TD><TD>#CreateODBCTime("9:42 PM")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>CreateTime(8, 30, 0)</TD><TD>#CreateODBCTime(CreateTime(8, 30, 0))#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>"12/31/1999 23:59:59"</TD><TD>#CreateODBCTime("12/31/1999 23:59:59")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
